message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities.  
In Atlanta, noise violations are generally handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** (for immediate enforcement) and the **Department of Public Safety – Code Enforcement** (for follow‑up investigations and citations).

### How to file a complaint

| Step | What to do | Where to go |
|------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | Gather details | Note the address, time, duration, and description of the noise. |
| 2 | Call the Police Hotline | **311** (within Atlanta) or **(404) 656‑3111** (outside Atlanta). |
| 3 | File online | Use the City of Atlanta’s “Report a Problem” portal: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| 4 | Follow up | If you don’t hear back within a few days, call the Code Enforcement office at **(404) 656‑3111** or email **code.enforcement@atlantaga.gov**. |

### Quick links

* **Atlanta 311 portal** – <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311>
* **Police Department – Noise Complaints** – <https://www.atlantaga.gov/police/noise-complaints>
* **Code Enforcement** – <https://www.atlantaga.gov/code-enforcement>

If you’re outside the city limits but still in the greater Atlanta area, you may need to contact the county sheriff’s office or the relevant municipal authority. But for most residents, the above resources will let you report noise issues directly to the local council (via the city’s public safety departments).
